column1: # Singularity Desktop upstream source pins -- the exact upstream commits the
# NCZ-OS payload (ncz-singularity-desktop) is built from, and the commits the
# downstream patch queue in assets/singularity/patches/ is verified against.
# build/preflight-freshness-gate.sh both go through it). A build that would
# clone a repository with no row here FAILS with the missing path named; it
# never falls back to a moving branch head.
#           a superproject submodule (every path in the pinned superproject's
#           .gitmodules must have a row); vetro and singularity-boot-splash =
#           the two standalone repositories build-singularity.sh clones.
#   branch  the branch the pin was taken from ("-" = no tracked branch: the
#           superproject's own gitlink is authoritative and must match)
# Derivation (2026-10-06): the r199 images (tag v26.10-r199, d7ab4948) built
# their payload from the superproject's master head with every submodule
# re-pinned to its tracked branch head, at about 08:00-09:00Z on 2026-10-06.
# These rows are those heads: the superproject 5c75e563d10e is the "g5c75e563d10e"
# in the earlier +deps1 package version, every tracked branch's newest
# first-parent commit before 2026-10-06T12:00Z is dated 2026-09-25 or older,
# and the next commit on any of them is the upstream feature drop of
# labwc 4653655f..2da90c41, ...) that broke the patch queue. So the r199 build
# time inside that window does not change the answer.
